title: Phishing Email Response
description: Standard operating procedure for triaging and responding to reported phishing emails.
author: SOC Team

procedures.title: Initial Triage
procedures.description: Review the reported email and assess legitimacy.
procedures.actions:
1. Check sender address and SPF/DKIM/DMARC results
2. Analyze email headers
3. Inspect links and attachments in a sandbox

procedures.title: Threat Analysis
procedures.description: Determine whether the email is malicious.
procedures.actions:
1. Detonate attachments in a sandbox
2. Check URLs and domains against threat intel
3. Search the mail gateway for similar messages

procedures.title: Containment
procedures.description: Prevent further spread if the email is confirmed malicious.
procedures.actions:
1. Block sender domain and URLs
2. Purge the email from all mailboxes
3. Update mail filters and EDR blocklists

procedures.title: User Communication
procedures.description: Notify affected users and close the loop.
procedures.actions:
1. Send a security advisory
2. Provide reporting guidance
3. Track click/credential-entry victims for follow-up
